title: Levitan's 'Water Margin'
content: When he painted "The Water Margin in 1898," Isaac Levitan had been suffering heart problems and knew he was nearing the end of his lifeIsaac Levitan (1868-1900)--The Water Margin -- 1898He said: "You probably think that my future landscapes will be soaked in pessimism, so to speak? Don’t worry, I love nature too much."
